anomalies.observed: U2 (TPS62933 buck regulator) pin 2 (EN) has no net. The netlist shows it only as "unconnected-(U2-EN-Pad2)" with type input+no_connect, so the enable input floats.
anomalies.expected: The TPS62933 EN pin should be tied to a defined level (for example VIN through a divider or pull-up) so the converter starts reliably. The spec does not describe EN, so this is judged from standard practice for this part.
anomalies.impact: If the EN input has no internal pull-up, the 5 V buck may never start, which would leave the ESP32 5V0 rail, the AZ1117 3.3 V rail and every downstream sensor unpowered. If the part has an internal pull-up, the impact is nil. I could not confirm which from the files.

parsed.summary: I found no shorts, bad pin-to-net assignments, or clear value/rating errors across the netlist, and the pump drivers, isolators, I2C pull-ups and sense networks are internally consistent.
